authorBio: Abel is a physician and digital health strategist. He has led digital health programmes in Ethiopia and across Africa for about 10 years, from EMR rollouts in national health facilities to telemedicine operations, interoperability, governance and AI. He founded the Digital Health Digest so the people doing this work have one place to share what works, what fails and why.
